corrected_claim: In early August 2024 global markets crashed on US recession fears and the unwind of the yen carry trade. Nikkei fell about 2.5% on 1 Aug, 5.8% on 2 Aug and a historic 12.4% on 5 Aug 2024 (worst one-day drop since 1987) - a cumulative ~19% over the three sessions from the 31 July close; the NASDAQ fell more than 10% from its mid-July record to the Aug 5 low.

evidence.title: NIKKEI daily data via Yahoo Finance: 38,126 (Aug 1) -> 35,909 (Aug 2) -> 31,458 (Aug 5)
NASDAQ daily data via Yahoo Finance: record ~18,700 mid-Jul 2024 -> 16,200 on 5 Aug 2024 (-13%)
Wikipedia: 2024 stock market crash / August 5, 2024 selloff coverage

notes: Speaker's Monday figure ('about 7%') materially understates the actual 12.4% Nikkei crash; 'cumulative ~15%' understates ~19%. NASDAQ >10% decline from high is correct.

corrected_claim: Adani Enterprises collapsed from about Rs 3,400 (24 Jan 2023, report day) to an intraday low of Rs 1,017.50 on 3 Feb 2023 - a fall of ~70% over eight trading sessions (about two weeks), not two sessions - then rebounded above Rs 2,100 within days (closing Rs 2,164 on 8 Feb 2023) before further volatility. The group overall lost more than $104 billion in market value.

evidence.title: ADANIENT.NS daily OHLC via Yahoo Finance: close 3,442 (24 Jan 2023); intraday low 1,017.50 (3 Feb 2023); close 2,164.2 (8 Feb 2023)
Wikipedia: Adani Group - lost more than $104 billion in value after the Hindenburg report

notes: Direction correct, compressed timeline wrong: the ~Rs 3,000->1,000 collapse took around two weeks (8 sessions), and the bounce to ~Rs 2,200 also took several sessions.
